Before the Phase D campaign construction is complete, verify:

rulebook-v1.0.txt.before: Run the event trigger check when the player **actually crosses a consequential travel/exploration boundary** or undertakes a substantial time-consuming activity where an unexpected event is physically plausible. Examples: beginning a meaningful wilderness travel leg; entering a threatened frontier sector; making camp in unstable territory; a substantial interval exploring an active ruin; or crossing a politically contested route. Do NOT roll once per message, menu choice, ordinary purchase, every combat round, duplicate look at a clue, HUD inspection, level-up freeze, advance-confirmation click, or scene narration that consumes no game time. Precommit and record a unique transition ID; it gets at most one event trigger check. After an event activates, resolve or close that event before another check can interrupt it. Do not farm retries by splitting one trip into repeated tiny chat turns.
